scope: Kinematic marked-current definition and deterministic/analytic statistical calibration on REF-DUST-FB-01; no new dynamical causal-set ensemble

current.variables: nonnegative rest-mass transfer f_xy on declared future-oriented transport edges of a causal set, with known clock and detector marks
current.units: f_xy is mass, not mass/time and not a universal weight on every causal relation
current.conservation: outgoing minus incoming transfer equals declared source at each event
current.coarse_graining: sum edge transfers between an acyclic compatible block partition; internal transfers cancel
current.not_claimed: derived matter action, single-stream dust law, geometric reconstruction from bare order, quantum expectation or gravitational backreaction

reference.exterior_slicing: marginally bound Painleve-Gullstrand continuation of the surface proper time; spatial slices flat on both sides

matter_quadrature.detector_mass_bound: absolute error <= M/P for a radial interval; whole-ball mass exact

volume_windows.clipping: clip to the declared common time interval; no samples beyond it
volume_windows.exposure: Omega4=integral over the actual finite detector worldtube; A=Omega4/V3(T_center)
volume_windows.calibration_limit: A and lambda known in this reference; a new model needs independent calibration and its systematic uncertainty

counting_calibration.lambda0: 5000/min(Omega4 over all 315 base cells), determined from the fixed analytic design
counting_calibration.interval: central Garwood interval for Poisson mean; Bonferroni alpha=0.05/1260, no independence assumed
counting_calibration.target: both volume and density intervals wholly inside +/-5% of their declared reference, using deterministic mass bounds
counting_calibration.qualification: joint success probability lower bound >=0.95 for a density level, from exact Poisson tails and union bound; no Monte Carlo draws
counting_calibration.raw_control: use A_raw=window_duration; show uncorrected time-averaging bias
counting_calibration.zero_count: positive mass and N=0: volume lower limit zero, density upper limit infinity, HOLD; no pseudocount
counting_calibration.numerical_status: floating point evaluation of exact probability formulae, not certified interval arithmetic
